auditItems.description: Reviewed plans:audit completion items with resolving code/test citations; never inferred from test verdicts.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true inside the recipe. Keep outer code:run dryRun false so audit/certifier previews actually execute.

acknowledgeExisting.description: Explicitly acknowledge previously reviewed independent certification cards. Defaults to false; preserves the certifier's existing-card refusal unless true.

gapOwner.description: Concrete accountable owner; defaults to the invoking identity.
